title: Bill Richardson siphoning US nuclear secrets
place_text: Los Alamos / Department of Energy, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Bill Richardson was kind of in with the Clintons and he was a Secretary of Energy and he's there and he's just systematically siphoning American nuclear secrets.

plain: Michels claims that in the 1990s Bill Richardson, who was Secretary of Energy, the cabinet official in charge of America's nuclear weapons labs, was close to the Clintons and was "just systematically siphoning American nuclear secrets." Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site.
